global: pizzicato strings, tuba, clarinet, glockenspiel, light jazz drums, woodblock

sections.name: hook
sections.style: panicked comic crash: frantic pizzicato run, a big cymbal crash and glass-like glockenspiel shatter, then a held suspense tremolo

sections.name: cruise
sections.style: breezy sunny city jazz, cheerful walking bass and clarinet, confident and smooth, then an abrupt halt

sections.name: alarm
sections.style: tense ticking clock, alarm-like ding-ding glockenspiel, then deadpan sneaky tiptoe pizzicato

sections.name: reverse
sections.style: silly slow-motion backing-up tuba steps that build, then a slapstick crash hit with cymbal and broken glass sparkle

sections.name: aftermath
sections.style: relieved calm sigh, then curious investigating bassoon and pizzicato detective line

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm bouncy playful outro, glockenspiel and pizzicato, cheeky button ending
